subject: The one-month secret I wasn't going to tell you
preview_text: Your 28-day report card is in. The truth about your first month with the app might surprise you.
body_paragraphs: Look at you. A month in. That's not just downloading an app. That's showing up. Most people download, get overwhelmed by the form guides, and ghost us. You didn't. You stuck around. That says something.

Think about it. In 28 days, you've moved from guessing to having a system. You've seen our AI break down jockey form, track conditions, and weight advantages. You're no longer just reading a racecard; you're understanding it. That momentum is everything in this game. Don't let that sunk effort go to waste now.

To celebrate your month, I want you to check your 'Insights Dashboard'. It's been quietly compiling your activity. Tap it. See the races you've analyzed, the confidence scores you've tracked. It's your personal form guide. This is where you see how far you've come from day one.

Open your dashboard now. See your month laid out. It's the proof you're getting sharper. Then, use today's top-rated pick for Cheltenham. Your system is working. Keep it going. P.S. The users who check this dashboard in their first month are 3x more likely to spot a profitable longshot. Don't be the one who misses it.
